sloka: त्वां प्राप्य मे वधो वा स्याच्छापो वा यदि दारुणः ।भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम् ।। ७.८०.१५ ॥
transliteration: tvāṁ prāpya me vadho vā syācchāpo vā yadi dāruṇaḥ ।bhaktaṁ bhajasva māṁ bhīru bhajamānaṁ suvihvalam ।। 7.80.15 ॥

translations.english: O timid one, even if I obtain you and face death or a terrible curse, please accept me, your devoted servant who is greatly agitated.
